customer_name: Unnamed Joint-Stock Commercial Bank (某股份制商业银行)
business_problem: The bank needed one enterprise large-model foundation that could serve marketing, risk control, document Q&A, coding, and customer-service scenarios instead of leaving AI capabilities fragmented across separate teams and tools.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud helped the bank build a bank-wide large-model stack on the Qianfan platform. At the infrastructure layer, the project established a heterogeneous model-service cluster to support both training and inference. At the platform layer, Qianfan unified data preparation, training, evaluation, tuning, and deployment so models could be governed across their full lifecycle. On top of that stack, the bank adopted enterprise-grade visual scenario debugging and document-data preprocessing to ground applications on internal financial and insurance content. Reusable AI-native services, including Wenxin Kuaima for developers, knowledge-retrieval middleware for document Q&A, and an intelligent customer-service assistant that summarizes live customer issues and recommends answers, were exposed to business teams so new use cases could launch on a shared governed platform rather than duplicated point solutions.
products_used: Visual Scenario Debugging and Document Preprocessing Framework

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides unified model lifecycle management for training, evaluation, tuning, and deployment across banking use cases.

solution_components.name: Heterogeneous Model Service Cluster
solution_components.role: Supplies the compute environment used to train and serve large models for enterprise workloads.

solution_components.name: Visual Scenario Debugging and Document Preprocessing Framework
solution_components.role: Prepares enterprise documents and lets teams visually configure and test large-model applications for different business scenarios.

solution_components.name: Wenxin Kuaima
solution_components.role: Acts as the bank's coding assistant for engineering teams building and maintaining business applications.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Retrieval Middleware
solution_components.role: Grounds question answering on enterprise insurance and business documents so users can retrieve reliable answers quickly.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Customer Service Assistant
solution_components.role: Summarizes customer questions in real time and recommends candidate answers to service staff.

data_flow: Internal business and insurance documents are preprocessed through the enterprise framework, then routed into Qianfan-managed large models running on the heterogeneous cluster. Grounded retrieval results and model outputs are served back into coding, knowledge-Q&A, and customer-service experiences, where agents and employees receive recommendations, summaries, and generated responses.
business_outcome: The bank created a reusable generative-AI foundation that lowered development cost, improved knowledge retrieval and service quality, and gave multiple business lines a faster path from experimentation to production.
metrics: Annual engineering labor costs could fall by more than 20% with Wenxin Kuaima.
Insurance-document knowledge-retrieval coverage accuracy can reach more than 85%.
Customer-service knowledge recommendation accuracy is expected to improve from 30% to more than 60%.
Average call duration can be reduced by 15 seconds.
architecture_clues: The stack spans infrastructure, platform, framework, and application layers for bank-wide generative-AI delivery.
The bank built a heterogeneous model-service cluster specifically to support large-model training and inference.
Enterprise document preprocessing is part of the application-development framework so internal files can ground model behavior.

evidence_quotes: Baidu AI Cloud helped the bank build a unified large-model technical system for the entire bank (original: 百度智能云助力该股份制商业银行建设全行统一的大模型技术体系).

The project built a heterogeneous service cluster at the AI infrastructure layer and unified training, evaluation, and optimization at the platform layer (original: 在AI基础设施层，建设大模型异构服务集群; 平台层，对大模型全生命周期的数据训练、评估、优化等流程进行统一管理).
The development framework provides enterprise-grade visual scenario debugging and enterprise document data preprocessing (original: 为大模型应用提供企业级的场景可视化调试、企业文档数据预处理能力等支持).
At the application layer, AI-native tools such as the code assistant and intelligent customer service can be used out of the box (original: 应用层，代码助手、智能客服等百度智能云AI原生应用可开箱即用).

Knowledge-retrieval coverage accuracy can reach more than 85%, and customer-service recommendation accuracy is expected to rise from 30% to above 60% while average talk time drops by 15 seconds (original: 检索覆盖准确率可达85%+；预计可将知识推荐的准确率从传统NLP的30%提升到60%以上，降低平均通话时长15秒).
